events.text:
I wrote the capture plan for all 22 screenshot slots and pushed it to main (d3241ce3). No screenshots were taken, and T-115 stays blocked until you run one desktop session.

**What's needed from you (one sitting covers T-115, T-140, T-133 and T-348, tracked as T-384):** in the Brave profile that Claude in Chrome uses, sign in at https://console.twilio.com and re-enter your password at https://admin.google.com/ac/users. Then open a Claude Code desktop session with Claude in Chrome connected and type "Act on T-115 and T-339".

| Item | State |
|---|---|
| Capture plan (`scripts/walkthroughs/journeys/guide-t115-capture-manifest.md`) | **Done.** 22 slots: the 19 this task's spec lists (it says 22, but only names 19; the decision's "21 ready" is also off) plus T-140's 3. Each slot has its URL, the screen to reach, what to blur, the output image path and the exact placeholder line to remove. A script confirmed all 22 placeholder lines match the guide files. |
| Demo sheet rows for s1-cold-email #7 (`scripts/walkthroughs/demo-sheets/s1-cold-email-07.csv`) | **Done.** Made-up rows on reserved example domains. |
| Revert ledger template (end of `REVERT_LEDGER.md`) | **Done.** Placeholder rows for the draft campaign, demo sheet, Google Admin form, Cloudflare search and the view-only screens. |
| Commit and push | **Done.** Commit d3241ce3, pushed to main. Only the 3 files above were staged, and the text has no long dashes. |
| Guide check | **Done.** check-guides passes with 57 slots still waiting for a screenshot. |
| Task status and note | **Done.** T-115 set to blocked with the one batched ask above, and note F-bb4cfb67 acknowledged. |
| Real screenshots for the 22 slots | **Blocked.** These need your desktop session (T-384). |
| Guide check with all 22 slots filled | **Blocked.** It can only be run after the screenshots exist. |
| Audit item G127 marked fixed | **Blocked.** That happens in the desktop session, once there is a commit with the screenshots. |

Some slots may stay empty even in that session. The plan skips any screen that would need a settings change or doesn't exist yet: the LinkedIn slots if no account is connected, s1-ads #1 if `generate_lead` isn't set up, the two "Adi test" contacts for s3 #13 if they don't exist, and the A/B and auto-withdraw screens if Tantra doesn't have them. s1-cold-email #11 asks for a test email that actually landed, but sending is not approved, so the plan captures the review screen instead.
